title: Registering and Gifting Cartwise Gift Cards: Terms by Card Type
content:
Every card type in the Cartwise Gift Cards range can be registered by its holder to their Cartwise profile. Whether an unredeemed card can be given to another person differs by card type.

| Card type | Holder can register the card to their profile | Unredeemed card can be given to another person |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Yes | Yes |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Yes | Yes |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Yes | No |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Yes | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Yes | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | Yes | No |

## Terms

1. **Registration.** Registration is available on all six card types: the holder may register the card to their own profile.
2. **Giving a card to another person.** An unredeemed card is transferable between profiles on the Cartwise eGift Card, the Cartwise Plastic Gift Card, the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card and the Cartwise Corporate Gift Card. The Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card and the Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card are not transferable between profiles.

## Two card types compared (hypothetical)

| | Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card |
|---|---|---|
| A holder registers the card to their own profile | Available | Available |
| The card is transferable to a profile other than the purchaser's | Yes | No |
